x: Radioactive pollution causes hereditary (genetic) changes and cancer. Heavy radiation also damages blood-forming tissue and blood vessels, which is why the official key counts statement III as well. Mineral imbalance in soil is not an effect.
source: printed (official UPPSC 2009) key; Rocket Environment p.63; NextGen Environment 11 p.6
evidence: Shankar Environment Part 7 (src/environment/shankar-environment-07.ocr.txt) p.5 (long-range effects: mutations, tumours, cancer)
dispute: Official/most-told key: I, III and IV. Rocket Environment p.63, NextGen 11 p.6 and Shankar Part 7 p.5 list only hereditary changes and cancer, which would give I and IV.
